design_prompt: An entirely original fictional English-speaking woodland creature called Orro. A very deep warm male voice with rounded chest resonance, a soft woody grain and a faint airy edge, clearly intelligible. Unhurried courteous phrasing, gently careful consonants and lightly rural English vowels. His enormous size is audible in the resonance, while kindness and shy humour remain close and humanly readable. Natural speech rather than a theatrical growl. Keep a stable vocal identity across whispering, laughter and fear. No imitation of any real person.
